split_policy.primary_axis: behavior phase before public reporting source family, schema anchor, workflow action, generated report, tmp artifact, badge, scorecard, or public claim language
split_policy.positive_rule: public conformance reporting rows can cite canonical behavior only through parser, sema, lowering, IR, runtime, or e2e owners in the upstream evidence families
split_policy.provenance_rule: dashboard schemas, scorecard schemas, generated summaries, tmp reports, tmp artifacts, badges, release-evidence bundles, workflow actions, and public summaries are provenance or routing until a behavior owner claims the underlying behavior
split_policy.retired_surface_rule: report-only support, generated-report-only support, dashboard-only support, provisional-as-claim-ready promotion, blocked/quarantined evidence promotion, compatibility, shim, fallback, old-mode, and unsupported public claim language are canonical rejection, strict-error, or provenance-only evidence
